subject: Live lab workshop — scheduling options and prep
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Claire Hu <claire@meridian.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Live lab workshop — scheduling options and prep

Hi Claire,

Thanks again for the time last week — excited to run the live lab with the Meridian team. We want this session to be hands-on (prompt review, routing config, and a short load verification run). Proposed slots (Pacific time):

- Tue Apr 20, 10:00–12:00 PT (best for us)
- Tue Apr 20, 14:00–16:00 PT
- Wed Apr 21, 09:00–11:00 PT

Agenda (high level):
- 10 min: intros & success criteria
- 30 min: prompt review + prompt-suite quick tuning
- 45 min: routing & model variant demo (latency/cost tradeoffs)
- 20 min: short load verification (burst to 200 rps for 5m) + results
- 15 min: actions/next steps

Prep and asks:
- Please share 1–2 representative prompts and a small sample of the request/response schema (CSV or JSON).
- Confirm who will join from your infra team (we recommend including the person who can provide network/access details).
- We attached two short prep files: prework-questions.pdf and redwood-workshop-runbook.md.

If none of the slots works, send alternative windows and we’ll try to accommodate.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com

Attachments: prework-questions.pdf (1 page), redwood-workshop-runbook.md (markdown)

Hi Naomi,

Thanks — excited to get hands-on. The team prefers Tue Apr 20 but later in the afternoon would be better so we can loop in EMEA folks (we’re distributed). Can you do Tue Apr 20, 15:00–17:00 PT instead?

Also cc’ing Alex (our infra lead) — Alex, can you confirm whether we can provide a small anonymized sample dataset and a temp service account for the short load test? We only need access for the 20–30 minute validation window.

Claire Hu

Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Live lab workshop — scheduling options and prep

Claire — Tue Apr 20, 15:00–17:00 PT works for us. I’ve updated the calendar invite (see link below) and added a short shared Drive folder with prep material.

Quick logistics and owners for the session:
- Naomi (me): facilitator + prompt review lead
- Monica Patel (on this thread): prompt sensitivity and evaluation harness owner
- Dev Patel: will run the routing demo and validate config changes
- Jonas Weber: responsible for load verification and collecting metrics

Pre-session asks (before Tue 15:00 PT):
- Meridian: share one anonymized sample dataset + a small set of representative prompts (Claire/Alex)
- Meridian: provide a temporary service account or a test endpoint for the 5–10 minute load burst (Alex)

I attached a tiny sample schema file (sample-schema.json) to show the shape we expect. If you can drop the sample data into the shared Drive folder, Dev and Jonas will pick it up and prepare the runbook.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-meridian-workshop
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-meridian-live-lab-20270420

See you Tuesday — Naomi

Naomi Feldman

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Live lab — post-session recap & action log (Meridian Analytics)

Team — quick recap and actions from today’s hands-on lab with Meridian Analytics. Outcome: session successful, routing test and short load burst completed; we observed expected latency variance across model variants and captured metrics. Highlights and actions below.

Summary:
- Session length: 15:00–16:50 PT (1h50m).
- Load: 200 rps burst for 5 minutes; no infra errors, 95th pct latency increased ~1.8x for quantized variant.
- Prompts: two prompts were tuned on-session (v1 -> v1.1) with minor prompt-template fixes.

Action items:
- Monica Patel: run prompt sensitivity suite on the 1.1 prompts and record quality delta. Due: 2027-04-23.
- Dev Patel: finalize routing rules in Meridian's staging environment (rule to prefer faster variant for short-prompt flows). Confirm config pushed. Due: 2027-04-22.
- Jonas Weber: provide detailed load test metrics (CSV with timestamps and token counts) and a short write-up on the latency profile. Due: 2027-04-21.
- Meridian (Claire/Alex): upload anonymized sample dataset to the Drive folder and confirm test account for next run. Due: 2027-04-21.

Next session proposal:
- Follow-up deep-dive and extended load window (30m at sustained 150 rps) — propose week of Apr 26. Naomi to propose two slots once internal owners confirm readiness.

Notes: attach the runbook we used and Jonas' quick metrics export in the shared folder. I’ll also add these action items to the HubSpot deal (ID HS-98312).

Thanks all — solid session.
Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: redwood-workshop-runbook.md, metrics-raw.csv (Jonas will upload)
